name: calendly
description: Calendly API v2 MCP server with 66 tools for scheduling, contacts, custom fields, Notetaker recaps, transcripts, organizations and webhooks.
long_description: 44 reads and 22 confirmed writes. Booking/cancellation can notify participants. Requires current API scopes and account features. Private credentials never bundle.

api_token.title: Private Calendly PAT
api_token.description: Scoped Personal Access Token; leave empty when using a file. Never paste into chat.

token_file.title: Private PAT text file
token_file.description: Absolute owner-only regular token-only file, max 64 KB. Leave empty for OAuth.

tokens_file.title: Private REST OAuth JSON file
tokens_file.description: Existing authorized grant in an owner-only regular file, max 64 KB. Writable parent directory required for single-use rotation; no PAT mixing.

allow_destructive.title: Allow confirmed writes
allow_destructive.description: If disabled refuse all 22 writes even when confirmed.
